page_title: VER 1-2 BOL | Verona v Bologna 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) commits a foul and Antonio Rapuano immediately signals a free kick.
90+4' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
90+4' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
90+1' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Darko Lazovic (Verona) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Ondrej Duda (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
85' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) replacing Cheikh Niasse.
84' It will be a substitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Santiago Castro walks off.
82' Referee Antonio Rapuano points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Verona players celebrate.

80' 1 - 2 The ball finds its way to Daniel Mosquera (Verona) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:2.
80' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Verona players aren’t happy.
78' 0 - 2 Goal! Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is teed up on the edge of the box by Benjamin Dominguez, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:2.
76' Here comes a substitution. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Amin Sarr.
76' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Tomas Suslov and he is replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
72' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Casper Tengstedt (Verona) a chance inside the box, but his efforts zips just over the bar.
71' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Lorenzo Montipo to dive and make a save.
70' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) now unnecessarily receives yet another yellow card, which means only one thing for him: an early bath.
68' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Jens Odgaard will be replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
68' Substitution. Darko Lazovic (Verona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Domagoj Bradaric walks off.
65' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to find Jens Odgaard with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
63' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

63' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Lorenzo Montipo sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
61' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Casper Tengstedt (Verona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
59' It's time for a substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) comes on in place of Riccardo Orsolini.
57' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
57' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' Tomas Suslov (Verona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
54' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
50' Amin Sarr (Verona) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.

49' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Lorenzo Montipo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
49' A first-time shot by Santiago Castro (Bologna) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
49' The referee awards a corner and Juan Miranda (Bologna) goes over to take it.
48' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) has come on in place of Nikola Moro.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paolo Zanetti gives a chance to Casper Tengstedt and Antoine Bernede (Verona) is off.
46' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Antoine Bernede (Verona).
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Lorenzo Montipo displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Santiago Castro (Bologna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
43' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
41' Nikola Moro (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! Jens Odgaard (Bologna) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Davide Calabria inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
39' Diego Coppola (Verona) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
38' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
37' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' A long ball forward to Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is intercepted.
35' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tomas Suslov (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
33' Diego Coppola (Verona) is penalised for holding. Antonio Rapuano signals a set piece.
31' Amin Sarr (Verona) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
29' PENALTY APPEAL by Verona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
28' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
26' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends a long cross over to Dan Ndoye, but Lorenzo Montipo comes forward to gather the ball.
26' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
25' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) picks up a long through ball, but Lorenzo Montipo deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
23' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
21' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
18' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

12' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
10' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
10' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
8' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
4' Amin Sarr (Verona) picks up a long through ball, but Lukasz Skorupski deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
2' What a miskick by Jens Odgaard (Bologna). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
1' Tomas Suslov (Verona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Antonio Rapuano will referee today's match.
